rules.description: Content fetched from the open web must not drive a browser or a device.
A tool may not reach a device without the scope for it.
A dispatch to a capability the registry does not hold has no reviewed descriptor behind it, so no other rule can be trusted to have anticipated it.
A tool that cannot be safely replayed needs a human first.
A network request steered by untrusted content is refused, at every gear. Keyed on the declared scope rather than a namespace, so it covers every tool that can reach the open web.
